title: Kling Omni character edit
description: Changes the person in your clip into the character in your picture, with Kling 3.0 Omni Edit on Comfy Cloud. Give a clip, a character picture and what to change. The clip keeps its own length. Kling bills by the second of output: about $0.13 a second at 720p and $0.17 at 1080p.

requirements.name: LoadVideo
requirements.instructions: Comfy Cloud needs the core node LoadVideo.

requirements.name: LoadImage
requirements.instructions: Comfy Cloud needs the core node LoadImage.

requirements.name: KlingOmniProEditVideoNode
requirements.instructions: Comfy Cloud needs the Kling Omni Edit Video node.

requirements.name: SaveVideo
requirements.instructions: Comfy Cloud needs the core node SaveVideo.

evidence: 2026-10-27: graph from Comfy's own api_kling_omni_edit_video template, cut to one clip and one character picture. The node takes a clip of 3 to 10 s at 720 to 2160 px, keeps the clip's own length, and holds up to 4 reference pictures with a video. Comfy's price badge for this node is $0.126 a second at 720p and $0.168 a second at 1080p.
Not yet run on Comfy Cloud: this task spent no credits. The graph, the node input names and the prices come from Comfy's template and node source of 2026-10-27.

licenses.software: ComfyUI core (GPL-3.0) runs this graph on Comfy Cloud; the Kling model itself is a paid service of Kuaishou.
